recurring_problems.pattern: Signals fire, conditions change, trade enters stale. SHORT stale trades consistently lose.
recurring_problems.root_cause: No staleness-aware entry filter. Compactor fires but market moves before execution.
recurring_problems.recommended_fix: Add staleness gate: if is_stale=True AND direction=SHORT AND RSI<35, block entry

recurring_problems.pattern: Most signals designed for EXTREME/HIGH volatility. In NORMAL (low vol), entries are choppy.
recurring_problems.root_cause: Mean-reversion signals need volatility to generate edge. LOW vol = noise.
recurring_problems.recommended_fix: Reduce position size or increase confidence threshold in NORMAL regime

recurring_problems.pattern: SHORT entries hit support, rr_engine forces exit at loss. Structural in NEUTRAL.
recurring_problems.root_cause: rr_engine support detection fires too eagerly on SHORT positions in NEUTRAL market.
recurring_problems.recommended_fix: Increase rr_engine SHORT support threshold or add regime awareness
